instrumentation.cleanup: First set all owned local events to0, then owned global events to0, unregister every owned callback, then free only owned tool_id5 in finally. Free alone is insufficient.
instrumentation.counted_subjects: The same two target paths and all their executed function names, including generator starts/resumes/throws. Records label this event evidence explicitly; no unmeasured old/new numeric comparison.
instrumentation.frame_access: No frame.f_code access in instrumentation counting callbacks; receive direct code object.
instrumentation.global_throw_filter: Count only exact preinstalled target CodeType identity; other codes return without counting. PY_THROW is not a supported local event.
instrumentation.ownership: Require get_tool(5) is None before use_tool_id; never disturb other tool ids.
instrumentation.registry: Before each of exactly two target execs recursively install every CodeType in the compiled code constants, including the module code. Keep strong references and exact object identity; never match a structurally equal unregistered code object.
instrumentation.source_tampering: Target sources cannot acquire or mutate monitoring. Preserve existing strict imports, AST dynamic/IO denials and audit; additionally reject monitoring API attributes in target Source.
